completionRule: Only every required terminal acceptance passing may be called project complete or Loop complete; a milestone is phase completion only.
invariants: Generation success and work qualification are separate durable states.
A severe technical defect hard-fails qualification and cannot be averaged away.
Shot and final-film gates fail closed when required evidence is absent, malformed, stale, or incomplete.
Rework is locally scoped where safe and is bounded by explicit retry and CNY budgets; no blind retry is permitted.
Paid model use requires necessity, per-action cost evidence, existing credentials, and a maximum of CNY 100 per action.
No external publication, destructive operation, credential disclosure, or scope expansion is implied.

requiredTerminalAcceptance.criteria: One director-owned versioned decision model governs intent, evidence, rejection, rework, and release eligibility across all supported types.
Creative, script, visual bible, dynamic storyboard, formal generation, post-production, and automatic QC are explicit durable stages with reviewed inputs and fail-closed transitions.
Character, scene, prop, style, and camera state have versioned identities and shot-to-shot continuity evidence.
Every shot and final film has technical and creative gates; severe technical errors hard-fail and missing evidence rejects.
Rejected evidence produces scoped rework directives with persisted retry count, estimated/actual cost, budget ceiling, and terminal exhaustion.
Comedy, talking-head, advertisement, narrative, and tutorial strategies are implemented and tested behind the unified director contract.
A versioned fixture covers 9:16/16:9/1:1, 15/30/60 seconds, live-action/animation/product/mixed-media, and monologue/dialogue/silent/music-beat modes with declared coverage.
Structured user feedback is attributable to project, revision, stage, strategy and evidence; proposed learning changes are versioned, evaluated, and never silently self-promoted.
HTTP, durable persistence, UI, and the real OpenReel workflow expose the same state machine, evidence, gates, and rework decisions.
Targeted, full local, negative, security, and deterministic fixed-set regression suites pass with retained evidence.
An immutable production candidate passes migration, backup/restore, rollback, observability, reliability, tenant, billing, and browser acceptance.
The reviewed candidate is deployed and accepted on root@123.57.67.213 using the standing OpenReel boundary, without publishing externally.
